summary_1line: Narada consoles the grieving king Srinjaya by recounting the immense wealth, sacrifices, and eventual deaths of great kings like Suhotra and Paurava.

image_candidates.scene_text: Golden rain falls from dark clouds over King Suhotra’s kingdom as rivers glitter like streams of liquid gold.
At a vast sacrifice, King Paurava distributes golden-decked elephants, horses, and ornamented maidens among gathered Brahmanas.
The sage Narada stands before the grieving King Srinjaya, who sits collapsed in sorrow for his dead son.
